digest.component_or_area: ticket state schema and write surfaces
propositions: bridge_project (tri-state: absent/empty/set) and repos (list) fields must be added to ticket state schema, seeded in make_initial_state, and projected by reducer from both CREATE and EDIT events
Both fields are writable at create time via --bridge-project and --repos arguments on CLI, library, and MCP write surfaces, producing identical state across all three
bridge_project is promote-only at edit time: setting it on an unbound ticket succeeds, but changing it on a ticket with an existing binding fails with non-zero exit and no state change
The three states of bridge_project (absent for legacy, empty string for never-sync, string value for sync target) must be distinguishable after replay
A ticket created before this change must replay identically except for the two new fields absent
